one_liner: Paygent (gopaygent.com) is an NMI-style payment gateway whose docs page mentions a Pathfinder API, Collect.js and Three-Step Redirect. The fetched pages don't show auth, endpoints, pricing or signup terms.
auth_notes: No fetched gopaygent.com page documents authentication. API_KEY is a guess based on typical NMI-style gateways (security key). The 'Bearer pgt_live_xxx' quote in the draft is not in the fetched pages. The Bearer pg_live_ pages belong to paygent.to, an unrelated product.
access_notes: The docs page only says 'Get access to wholesale rates and powerful developer tools instantly.' It gives no free-tier, sandbox or signup terms. The draft's 'Free plan available' quote is not in the fetched pages. A merchant account or paid plan is the most defensible assumption for a payment gateway, but this is unverified.
blocker_notes: The fetched docs page is a landing page. It names the Pathfinder API, Collect.js and Three-Step Redirect but has no endpoints, auth details or access terms. The docs.paygent.to and docs.paygentic.io pages are unrelated products and were ignored. Composio has no toolkit and the MCP registry has no entry, so no MCP was found.
